notes: STATIC — an interactive monochrome meditation on electromagnetic noise, dead air, and the space between stations. Built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and 2D canvas. No external dependencies, no frameworks, no image assets. Features seven generative canvas studies, a working Web Audio radio tuner, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, and screen-reader accessible copy. Model identity not exposed by runtime, so 'unknown-model' is used per instructions.
